description: Two-hop recall: the query's strongest direct match is seed A (the meridian conduit), but the expected detail lives in seed B (the bridge journal), one symbolic hop from A. The runner wires an ADR-69 link (A -Supports-> B, C -Supports-> B) and flips the cascade to the Emergency tier (gamma 0.20), so B's link evidence lifts it from plain fused rank 3 to rank <= 2 even though its raw cosine overlap with the query is weaker than the decoy C. Without the cascade, B stays at rank 3 and the query fails its bound.
seed_facts: The meridian relay conduit carries the weekly payload checksum signal to the audit tower.
The meridian report is due on Thursday at the station review.
The bridge journal logs the relay checksum parity factor for the daily audit.
distractors: The team evaluated switching to Go for the web dashboard backend.
The onboarding doc recommends Visual Studio Code for new contributors.
Concerto deployments historically used Python build scripts.
The probe binaries are released from the local cache.
